It was not that there were no literary specialists, but that people were not judged by their writing; it was not that there were no rules of composition, but that writing was not itself taken as the standard. Writing conveys the Way. The Way is grasped in the heart and takes form in words; when words form a patterned composition, this is simply what we call writing. As the ancients said, the words of a person of benevolence and righteousness are gracious …

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
如也固有以哉昔歐陽子號
知道者猶曰文章足以潤身
政事足以及物殊不知文章
不達於政則晉唐諸子有華
無實耳政事不澤於文則東
漢三公有事無政耳噫文章
政事其可釐而二乎哉自鄉
===
舉里選之法肇於周孝弟力
田之法行於漢當時人皆知
道文亦近古裔是而後取士
制異或以策試或以詩試或
以詞賦試文之純駁而道之
得失以之雖未近古然掄材
育秀亦成一代家法迨我
punctuated: 如也，固有以哉！昔歐陽子號知道者，猶曰：「文章足以潤身，政事足以及物。」殊不知文章不達於政，則晉唐諸子有華無實耳；政事不澤於文，則東漢三公有事無政耳。噫！文章政事，其可釐而二乎哉？自鄉舉里選之法肇於周，孝弟力田之法行於漢，當時人皆知道，文亦近古。裔是而後，取士制異，或以策試，或以詩試，或以詞賦試，文之純駁而道之得失以之。雖未近古，然掄材育秀，亦成一代家法。迨我
translation_en:
…so harmonious: surely there is a reason for this! Formerly, Master Ouyang, reputed to understand the Way, nevertheless said: “Literary accomplishment suffices to adorn oneself; governmental service suffices to benefit others.” He failed to realize that if literary accomplishment does not extend to government, the writers of the Jin and Tang possess mere ornament without substance; if governmental service is not enriched by literary cultivation, the Three Dukes of the Eastern Han have administrative business but no true governance. Alas! Can literary accomplishment and governmental service be separated into two things?

The method of recommending men from the districts and selecting them from the villages originated under the Zhou, and the method of recommending the filial, the fraternal, and those diligent in farming was practiced under the Han. At that time, people all understood the Way, and their writing, too, approached that of antiquity. Thereafter [?], the institutions for recruiting officials changed: some tested candidates through policy essays, others through poetry, and others through lyric compositions and rhapsodies. The purity or mixed quality of their writing, and their attainment or loss of the Way, followed from these methods. Although these did not approach antiquity, selecting talent and nurturing outstanding men nevertheless became an established practice particular to each dynasty. When it came to our …

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
朝設科取士崇儒右文其程式
則詳酌古制其額例則度量
時宜其遴選則務協輿論取
士之法至是大備以是百餘
年來文化誕敷無遠弗届况
福建為東南大藩古為閩越
地隋唐以前文物固尠自常
===
衮入閩而文風始變自歐陽
詹來泉山而文運始開自蕭
國梁鄭僑黄定百里三狀元
而文物始昌至我朱子講道
延平光啓正學而文教為之
大振迨今
□之盛作養日深彬彬乎冠蓋
punctuated: 朝設科取士，崇儒右文，其程式則詳酌古制，其額例則度量時宜，其遴選則務協輿論。取士之法至是大備，以是百餘年來，文化誕敷，無遠弗届。况福建為東南大藩，古為閩越地，隋唐以前，文物固尠。自常衮入閩而文風始變，自歐陽詹來泉山而文運始開，自蕭國梁、鄭僑、黄定，百里三狀元，而文物始昌。至我朱子講道延平，光啓正學，而文教為之大振。迨今□之盛，作養日深，彬彬乎冠蓋
translation_en: …our dynasty established examinations to recruit officials, honoring Confucian learning and esteeming literary cultivation. Its examination procedures were devised through careful consideration of ancient institutions; its quotas and regulations were determined according to contemporary needs; and its selection of candidates sought to accord with public judgment. The methods of recruiting officials thus became fully developed. Consequently, for more than a hundred years, civilizing influence has spread widely, reaching even the most distant places. Fujian, moreover, is a great province of the southeast, anciently the territory of Minyue. Before the Sui and Tang dynasties, its cultural accomplishments were indeed few. Only after Chang Gun entered Fujian did its literary climate begin to change; only after Ouyang Zhan came to Quanshan did its literary fortunes begin to unfold; and only with Xiao Guoliang, Zheng Qiao, and Huang Ding—three Palace Examination champions from within a hundred li—did its cultural accomplishments begin to flourish. When our Master Zhu expounded the Way at Yanping and gloriously advanced orthodox learning, literary and moral education received a great impetus. Down to the present flourishing of □ [?], the cultivation of talent has grown ever deeper day by day. How cultured and accomplished are those with official caps and carriage canopies…

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
之相望也渢渢乎絃誦之相
聞也比比乎科第之相輝也
較昔蓋倍蓰矣雖然始善須
慮其終文盛當防其敝諸士
子生斯世也際斯運也領斯
薦也亦云盛矣盍思所以慎
之其必砥名礪節無忘常衮
===
之所教者崇德尚義無愧歐
陽詹之所造者含英咀華無
劣鄭僑輩之所獻者而又究
極精微之蘊酌以義理之中
無失朱子之所傳者慎而又
慎俾後世不徒以文人文法
稱庶無負我
punctuated: 之相望也，渢渢乎絃誦之相聞也，比比乎科第之相輝也，較昔蓋倍蓰矣。雖然，始善須慮其終，文盛當防其敝。諸士子生斯世也，際斯運也，領斯薦也，亦云盛矣。盍思所以慎之？其必砥名礪節，無忘常衮之所教者；崇德尚義，無愧歐陽詹之所造者；含英咀華，無劣鄭僑輩之所獻者；而又究極精微之蘊，酌以義理之中，無失朱子之所傳者。慎而又慎，俾後世不徒以文人文法稱，庶無負我
translation_en: …officials follow one another in an unbroken succession; richly resounding, the sounds of strings and recitation answer one another; everywhere, examination successes lend one another their lustre. Compared with former times, these have surely increased severalfold. Nevertheless, a good beginning requires thought for its ending, and flourishing literary culture calls for vigilance against its abuses. You scholars, born into this age, encountering such good fortune, and receiving this recommendation, may indeed be said to enjoy great distinction. Why not consider how to exercise due care? You must temper your reputations and strengthen your integrity, never forgetting what Chang Gun taught; exalt virtue and esteem righteousness, proving worthy of Ouyang Zhan’s attainments; savour the finest blossoms of learning, offering nothing inferior to what Zheng Qiao and his peers presented. Moreover, you must fully explore the profound subtleties of learning and weigh them against the proper mean of moral principle, losing nothing of what Master Zhu transmitted. Be cautious, and cautious yet again, so that later generations will praise you for more than literary accomplishment and exemplary writing. Thus may you prove worthy of our…

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
家作育之
脫或孜孜汲汲藉文以媒利
祿是豈徒科目之羞抑亦爲
斯文之羞也可不勗哉
山東濟南府濱州儒學學正
周淵謹序
punctuated:
家作育之。脫或孜孜汲汲，藉文以媒利祿，是豈徒科目之羞，抑亦爲斯文之羞也，可不勗哉！
山東濟南府濱州儒學學正周淵謹序。
translation_en:
…the ruling house’s nurturing [of scholars; wording incomplete in the transcription][?]. Should anyone instead strive anxiously and unceasingly to use literary accomplishment to secure profit and official emoluments, would this merely disgrace the examination system? It would also disgrace this cultural tradition. Can you fail to exert yourselves!
Respectfully prefaced by Zhou Yuan, Instructor in the Confucian School of Binzhou, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong.

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
福建鄕試錄序
我
聖天子嗣登大寶臨御撫極體
祖宗成憲宵旰圖治切切然惟以
作養人材爲首務是以文風
丕振視昔加隆自
登極以迄于今一紀之間開科取
===
士凡三舉矣邇弘治戊午秋
復當天下試士之期于時巡
按福建監察御史張敏祗率
常典思惟
國家重事乃謀諸藩臬訪求儒
紳走幣聘之俾秉厥事時鎭
守太監鄧原提督市舶太監
punctuated:
福建鄕試錄序

我聖天子嗣登大寶，臨御撫極，體祖宗成憲，宵旰圖治，切切然惟以作養人材爲首務。是以文風丕振，視昔加隆。自登極以迄于今，一紀之間，開科取士凡三舉矣。邇弘治戊午秋，復當天下試士之期。于時，巡按福建監察御史張敏祗率常典，思惟國家重事，乃謀諸藩臬，訪求儒紳，走幣聘之，俾秉厥事。時鎭守太監鄧原、提督市舶太監
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Fujian Provincial Examination

Our sagely Son of Heaven succeeded to the imperial throne and assumed supreme rule. Following the established statutes of his imperial ancestors, he labors from before dawn until late at night to achieve good government, earnestly making the cultivation and nurture of talent his foremost concern. Consequently, literary learning has flourished greatly, surpassing its former heights. From his accession to the present, within one twelve-year cycle, examinations to select worthy men have been held three times.

Recently, in the autumn of the wuwu year of Hongzhi [1498], the time again arrived for examining scholars throughout the empire. Zhang Min, the Investigating Censor serving as Regional Inspector of Fujian, reverently followed the established regulations. Reflecting on the importance of this undertaking to the state, he consulted the provincial administration and surveillance authorities, sought out learned gentlemen, and dispatched invitations with gifts, asking them to take charge of the examination. At that time, Deng Yuan, the eunuch director assigned to regional defense, and the eunuch director superintending maritime trade …

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
劉廣皆雅重文敎清戎監察
御史郭維協德作興屆期輅
等俱至巡按御史合提學副
使韋斌所督興之士覆試而
去取之得一千六百有奇乃
入院內而提調監試則右布
政使李雲按察使朱瓚副使
===
陳振右參議王琳外而協賛
防範則左參政俞俊副使韓
紹宗馮玘左參議熊禄僉事
伍希閔賈錠張佐王寅富玹
曁內外執事恪恭匪懈而防
範嚴密綜理周至則御史寔
身任焉環棘三試之遵□□
punctuated: 劉廣皆雅重文敎，清戎監察御史郭維協德作興。屆期，輅等俱至。巡按御史合提學副使韋斌所督興之士，覆試而去取之，得一千六百有奇，乃入院。內而提調監試，則右布政使李雲、按察使朱瓚、副使陳振、右參議王琳；外而協賛防範，則左參政俞俊、副使韓紹宗、馮玘、左參議熊禄、僉事伍希閔、賈錠、張佐、王寅、富玹，曁內外執事，恪恭匪懈。而防範嚴密、綜理周至，則御史寔身任焉。環棘三試之，遵□□
translation_en:
…and Liu Guang both placed great value on literary education. Guo Wei, the Investigating Censor responsible for reviewing military registers, joined in their efforts to promote it. At the appointed time, Lu and the others all arrived. The Regional Inspector assembled the candidates whose education had been overseen and fostered by Wei Bin, the Surveillance Vice Commissioner in charge of education, and examined them again to determine whom to admit or reject. More than sixteen hundred were selected and then entered the examination compound.

Inside, those serving as Proctors and supervising the examination were Li Yun, Right Provincial Administration Commissioner; Zhu Zan, Provincial Surveillance Commissioner; Chen Zhen, Surveillance Vice Commissioner; and Wang Lin, Right Administration Assistant Commissioner. Outside, those assisting with security were Yu Jun, Left Administration Vice Commissioner; Han Shaozong and Feng Qi, Surveillance Vice Commissioners; Xiong Lu, Left Administration Assistant Commissioner; and Wu Ximin, Jia Ding, Zhang Zuo, Wang Yin, and Fu Xuan, Surveillance Assistant Commissioners. Together with the functionaries serving inside and outside, they carried out their duties respectfully and without slackening. The censor himself took responsibility for ensuring strict security and thorough overall management. Within the thorn-enclosed compound, the candidates were examined in three sessions, in accordance with [two illegible characters]…

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
制額得士之尤者九十人爰次其
氏名及表其文之最者成錄
因序之曰惟昔成周盛時文
武諸君用天保以上治內采
薇以下治外而鹿鳴寔首群
什其上下之間施報之際至
今猶可想見我
朝
列聖憲章文武等威采章秋毫不
容紊而獨於宴雋科之士顏
之曰鹿鳴金書標榜昭揭於
衆蓋宴雖藩垣而實以
君命將之也夫鹿鳴一章凡以宴
侯使國臣皆有官守爵土者
punctuated: 制額，得士之尤者九十人，爰次其氏名，及表其文之最者，成錄，因序之曰：惟昔成周盛時，文武諸君用《天保》以上治內，《采薇》以下治外，而《鹿鳴》寔首群什。其上下之間、施報之際，至今猶可想見。我朝列聖憲章文武，等威采章，秋毫不容紊，而獨於宴雋科之士，顏之曰「鹿鳴」，金書標榜，昭揭於衆。蓋宴雖藩垣，而實以君命將之也。夫《鹿鳴》一章，凡以宴侯使、國臣，皆有官守爵土者。
translation_en:
…the prescribed quota, selecting ninety of the most outstanding candidates. Their names were then arranged in order, and the finest of their compositions were singled out to form this record. Accordingly, I supplied a preface, saying:

In the flourishing age of Zhou of old, Kings Wen and Wu and the other rulers used the poems from “Heaven Protects” (Tianbao) back to the beginning to order internal affairs, and those from “Gathering Bracken” (Caiwei) onward to order external affairs. “The Deer Call” (Luming) stood at the head of these groups of poems. The relations between superior and subordinate, and the giving of favors and their requital, can still be imagined today.

The successive sage emperors of our dynasty have taken Wen and Wu as their models. In the distinctions of rank and the decorative insignia that express them, they permit not the slightest disorder. Yet when banqueting the distinguished men selected through the examination, they give the occasion the name “Deer Call,” displaying it prominently before all on a placard inscribed in gold. For although the banquet takes place in a province, it is in fact conducted by command of the sovereign.

Now, the poem “The Deer Call” was used to banquet the envoys of the feudal lords and the ministers of the realm—all men who held official responsibilities, noble rank, and lands…

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
而他弗濫與茲宴科士而襲
其名則於卷帙未擲衿褐未
釋之初已預待以侯度臣禮
加隆於成周遠甚初不嫌於
紊等威也乃若錙銖横斂
時禁厲甚而於科士輜重之需
則聽有司營辦何如歷科諸
===
省初不限以常數此尤曠聞
於古創見於今而亦鹿鳴承
筐是將意也夫以
皇明隆遇如許而豈徒哉諸生宴
鹿鳴納筐將北上聯捷歌天
保岡陵之辭以少荅
隆恩於萬一餘惟從容將順致
punctuated:
而他弗濫與。茲宴科士而襲其名，則於卷帙未擲、衿褐未釋之初，已預待以侯度臣禮，加隆於成周遠甚，初不嫌於紊等威也。乃若錙銖横斂，時禁厲甚，而於科士輜重之需，則聽有司營辦。何如歷科諸省，初不限以常數。此尤曠聞於古、創見於今，而亦《鹿鳴》「承筐是將」意也。
夫以皇明隆遇如許，而豈徒哉？諸生宴鹿鳴，納筐，將北上聯捷，歌《天保》岡陵之辭，以少荅隆恩於萬一。餘惟從容將順，致
translation_en:
…and others were not indiscriminately admitted. Now this banquet for successful examination candidates adopts that name: even before they have set aside their books or exchanged their scholars’ robes and coarse clothing, they are already accorded the treatment due to lords and the ceremonial courtesies due to ministers. This far surpasses the honors bestowed in the Zhou dynasty at its height, yet is not regarded as confusing the distinctions of rank and dignity. As for arbitrary exactions, even of the smallest amount, the current prohibitions are exceedingly strict; yet the responsible offices are permitted to arrange the supplies needed for the examination candidates’ journeys. In successive examinations throughout the provinces [?], these have never been restricted to a fixed amount. This, especially, was unheard of in antiquity and is seen for the first time today; it also embodies the meaning of “presenting baskets of gifts” in “The Deer Call” (Lu ming).
Can such generous treatment by our august Ming be without purpose? You scholars feast at the Deer Call banquet and receive the baskets of gifts; you will travel north and gain successive examination victories, singing the verses about hills and heights in “Heaven Protects You” (Tian bao), thereby repaying some tiny fraction of this immense gracious favor. For the rest, all that remains is calmly to support and further the ruler’s good purposes, bringing…

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
君於文武躋世於成周而已况今
外夷琛獻烽警晏然采薇出
戍之舉靡家効命之為我躬
弗預蓋
上之遇下視古加隆而下之報
上於今為易輅等觀行於言因已
試而逆探來效則其稱衍食
===
而乘車載免受直怠事之刺
也决矣然耕田舍己從井救
人與夫言庸相違令好相反
者先民所深忌尚相與懋諸
噫此告衆人者而獨於諸生
何哉蓋投諸樂聞畀諸能任
者爾是為序
punctuated:
君於文武，躋世於成周而已。况今外夷琛獻，烽警晏然，采薇出戍之舉、靡家効命之為，我躬弗預。蓋上之遇下，視古加隆，而下之報上，於今為易。輅等觀行於言，因已試而逆探來效，則其稱衍食而乘車，載免受直怠事之刺也，决矣。然耕田舍己，從井救人，與夫言庸相違、令好相反者，先民所深忌，尚相與懋諸！

噫！此告衆人者，而獨於諸生何哉？蓋投諸樂聞，畀諸能任者爾。是為序。
translation_en:
…bringing the ruler to the stature of Kings Wen and Wu and raising the age to the achievement of the Zhou—that is all. Moreover, today foreign peoples present precious tribute, and the frontier beacons give no alarm. As for marching out on garrison duty, as in “Gathering Bracken,” or serving at the cost of having no home life, we ourselves take no part. Thus the sovereign’s treatment of his subjects is more generous than in antiquity, while for subjects to repay their sovereign is now easier. We, Lu and the others, discern conduct through words; from what has already been tested, we anticipate their future accomplishments. We are therefore certain that they will prove worthy of their ample sustenance and carriage privileges [?], and escape the reproach of accepting payment while neglecting their duties [?]. Yet abandoning one’s own fields when farming, following someone into a well to rescue him, and allowing one’s words and conduct, or one’s commands and preferences, to contradict each other—these were things the ancients deeply deplored. May we encourage one another to exert ourselves in this!

Ah! These are admonitions for everyone; why address them specifically to you examination candidates? Simply because we offer them to those who delight in hearing them and entrust them to those capable of bearing the responsibility. This serves as the preface.

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
江西九江府儒學教授張輅
謹序
punctuated: 江西九江府儒學教授張輅謹序。
translation_en: Preface respectfully written by Zhang Lu, Instructor at the Confucian School of Jiujiang Prefecture, Jiangxi.

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
弘治十一年福建鄉試
監臨官
巡按福建監察御史張敏〔志學直隸祁門縣人辛丑進士〕
提調官
福建等處承宣布政使司右布政使李雲〔時望直隸宜興縣人乙未進士〕
福建等處承宣布政使司右參議王琳〔廷珮浙江嘉善縣人辛丑進士〕
監試官
福建等處提刑按察司按察使朱瓚〔朝用直隸肅寧縣人乙未進士〕
福建等處提刑按察司副使陳振〔時起浙江鄞縣人辛丑進士〕
===
考試官
江西九江府儒學教授張輅〔本素廣東博羅縣人癸卯貢士〕
山東濟南府濱州儒學學正周淵〔洪本浙江臨海縣人壬子貢士〕
同考試官
直隸淮安府邳州儒學學正侯汾〔守一浙江臨海縣人己酉貢士〕
湖廣郴州儒學學正韓宗堯〔仁卿廣東番禺縣人壬子貢士〕
河南開封府中牟縣儒學教諭熊宗堯〔唐夫直隸瀋陽中屯衛籍人壬子貢士〕
直隸保定府唐縣儒學教諭徐珪〔良璧浙江開化縣人己酉貢士〕
浙江紹興府會稽縣儒學教諭徐夢麒〔吉生應天府江寧縣人丙午貢士〕
punctuated:
弘治十一年福建鄉試

監臨官
巡按福建監察御史張敏〔志學，直隸祁門縣人，辛丑進士〕。

提調官
福建等處承宣布政使司右布政使李雲〔時望，直隸宜興縣人，乙未進士〕。福建等處承宣布政使司右參議王琳〔廷珮，浙江嘉善縣人，辛丑進士〕。

監試官
福建等處提刑按察司按察使朱瓚〔朝用，直隸肅寧縣人，乙未進士〕。福建等處提刑按察司副使陳振〔時起，浙江鄞縣人，辛丑進士〕。

考試官

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
第壹場
四書
子語魯大師樂曰樂其可知也始作翕如
也從之純如也皦如也繹如也以成
誠者自成也而道自道也誠者物之終始
不誠無物是故君子誠之為貴誠者
非自成己而已也所以成物也成己
仁也成物知也性之德也合内外之
道也故時措之宜也
===
取諸人以為善是與人為善者也故君子
莫大乎與人為善
易經
聖人以神道設教而天下服矣象曰風行
地上觀先王以省方觀民設教
勿憂宜日中宜照天下也
廣大配天地變通配四時陰陽之義配日
月易簡之善配至德
和順於道德而理於義
punctuated:
第壹場

四書

子語魯大師樂，曰：「樂其可知也：始作，翕如也；從之，純如也，皦如也，繹如也，以成。」

誠者，自成也，而道，自道也。誠者，物之終始；不誠，無物。是故君子誠之為貴。誠者，非自成己而已也，所以成物也。成己，仁也；成物，知也。性之德也，合内外之道也，故時措之宜也。

取諸人以為善，是與人為善者也。故君子莫大乎與人為善。

易經

聖人以神道設教，而天下服矣。象曰：「風行地上，觀；先王以省方觀民設教。」

勿憂，宜日中，宜照天下也。

廣大配天地，變通配四時，陰陽之義配日月，易簡之善配至德。

和順於道德，而理於義。
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

The Master spoke about music to the Grand Music Master of Lu, saying: “Music can indeed be understood. When it begins, the sounds come together in harmony. As it proceeds, they are harmonious, distinct, and continuous, until the piece is completed.”

Sincerity is that by which one completes oneself; the Way is that by which one guides oneself. Sincerity is the beginning and end of things. Without sincerity, there would be nothing. Thus the gentleman prizes sincerity. Sincerity does not merely complete oneself; it also serves to bring other things to completion. Completing oneself is benevolence; bringing other things to completion is wisdom. These are virtues of our nature, and the Way that unites the inner and the outer. Thus, whenever they are put into practice, they are fitting.

To draw upon others in doing good is to join with others in doing good. Thus, for the gentleman, nothing is greater than joining with others in doing good.

Book of Changes

The sages established their teaching through the numinous Way, and all under Heaven submitted. The Image commentary says: “Wind moves over the earth: Contemplation. The former kings accordingly inspected the regions, observed the people, and established their teaching.”

“Do not worry; it is fitting to be like the sun at noon”: it is fitting to illuminate all under Heaven.

Its breadth and greatness match Heaven and Earth; its change and adaptation match the four seasons; the principles of yin and yang match the sun and moon; the excellence of its ease and simplicity matches the highest virtue.

It accords harmoniously with the Way and virtue, and is ordered according to righteousness.

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
書經
帝德廣運乃聖乃神乃武乃文皇天眷命
奄有四海爲天下君
慎厥終惟其始
無偏無黨王道蕩蕩無黨無偏王道平平
穆穆在上明明在下灼于四方罔不惟德
之勤故乃明于刑之中率乂于民棐
彝
詩經
===
二之日鑿冰冲冲三之日納于凌陰四之
日其蚤獻羔祭韭九月肅霜十月滌
場朋酒斯饗曰殺羔羊躋彼公堂稱
彼兕觥萬壽無疆
大田多稼既種既戒既備乃事以我覃耜
俶載南畝播厥百穀既庭且碩曾孫
是若
明明在下赫赫在上
儀式刑文王之典日靖四方
punctuated:
書經
帝德廣運，乃聖乃神，乃武乃文。皇天眷命，奄有四海，爲天下君。
慎厥終，惟其始。
無偏無黨，王道蕩蕩；無黨無偏，王道平平。
穆穆在上，明明在下，灼于四方，罔不惟德之勤，故乃明于刑之中，率乂于民，棐彝。

詩經
二之日鑿冰冲冲，三之日納于凌陰。四之日其蚤，獻羔祭韭。九月肅霜，十月滌場。朋酒斯饗，曰殺羔羊。躋彼公堂，稱彼兕觥，萬壽無疆！
大田多稼，既種既戒，既備乃事。以我覃耜，俶載南畝，播厥百穀。既庭且碩，曾孫是若。
明明在下，赫赫在上。
儀式刑文王之典，日靖四方。
translation_en:
Book of Documents (Shujing)
The sovereign’s virtue was far-reaching and all-embracing: sagely and spirit-like, martial and cultivated. August Heaven bestowed its favor and mandate upon him; he possessed all within the Four Seas and became ruler of all under Heaven.
Take care over the end as you do over the beginning.
Without partiality or faction, the kingly Way is broad and open; without faction or partiality, the kingly Way is level and even.
Reverent and dignified above, discerning and enlightened below, their influence shone throughout the four quarters. All diligently pursued virtue. Thus they understood the proper balance in punishments, guiding and governing the people and supporting the enduring norms.

Book of Odes (Shijing)
In the second month, they hew the ice with resounding blows; in the third month, they store it in the icehouse. Early in the fourth month, they offer a lamb and sacrifice with chives. In the ninth month, the frost bites; in the tenth month, they clear the threshing ground. With paired vessels of ale they hold a feast, and slaughter lambs and sheep. They ascend the public hall and raise the rhinoceros-horn cup: may you live ten thousand years, without end!
The great fields bear abundant crops. The seed has been selected, preparations made, and all is ready for your work. With our sharp plowshares, we begin work on the southern fields and sow the many grains. They grow straight and tall; the great-grandson is pleased.
Brightly enlightened below, gloriously radiant above.
Follow and emulate King Wen’s statutes, daily bringing peace to the four quarters.

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
春秋
元年春王正月〔隱公元年〕
鄭人来輸平〔隱公六年〕鄭伯使宛来歸祊〔隱〕
〔公八年〕公會齊侯于防〔隱公九年〕公會齊
侯鄭伯于中丘公敗宋師于菅〔並〕
〔隱公十年〕公及齊侯鄭伯入許〔隱公十一年〕
元年春王正月公即位鄭伯以璧
假許田〔並桓公元年〕蔡侯鄭伯會于鄧
〔桓公二年〕楚人伐鄭〔僖公元年〕楚人侵鄭
===
〔僖公二年〕楚人伐鄭〔僖公三年〕公會齊侯
宋公陳侯衛侯鄭伯許男曹伯侵蔡
蔡潰遂伐楚〔僖公四年〕諸侯盟于葵丘
〔僖公九年〕楚人滅黃〔僖公十二年〕楚人敗徐
于婁林〔僖公十五年〕宋公曹人邾人盟于
曹南會陳人蔡人楚人鄭人盟于
齊〔並僖公十九年〕宋人齊人楚人盟于鹿
上宋公楚子陳侯蔡侯鄭伯許男
曹伯會于盂執宋公以伐宋〔並僖公〕
punctuated:
春秋

元年春，王正月。〔隱公元年〕鄭人来輸平。〔隱公六年〕鄭伯使宛来歸祊。〔隱〕〔公八年〕公會齊侯于防。〔隱公九年〕公會齊侯、鄭伯于中丘。公敗宋師于菅。〔並〕〔隱公十年〕公及齊侯、鄭伯入許。〔隱公十一年〕元年春，王正月，公即位。鄭伯以璧假許田。〔並桓公元年〕蔡侯、鄭伯會于鄧。〔桓公二年〕楚人伐鄭。〔僖公元年〕楚人侵鄭。〔僖公二年〕楚人伐鄭。〔僖公三年〕公會齊侯、宋公、陳侯、衛侯、鄭伯、許男、曹伯侵蔡。蔡潰，遂伐楚。〔僖公四年〕諸侯盟于葵丘。〔僖公九年〕楚人滅黃。〔僖公十二年〕楚人敗徐于婁林。〔僖公十五年〕宋公、曹人、邾人盟于曹南。會陳人、蔡人、楚人、鄭人盟于齊。〔並僖公十九年〕宋人、齊人、楚人盟于鹿上。宋公、楚子、陳侯、蔡侯、鄭伯、許男、曹伯會于盂，執宋公以伐宋。〔並僖公〕
translation_en:
Spring and Autumn Annals

In the first year, in spring, in the first month of the royal calendar. 〔First year of Duke Yin.〕 Men of Zheng came to offer peace. 〔Sixth year of Duke Yin.〕 The Earl of Zheng sent Wan to come and transfer Beng to Lu. 〔Eighth year of Duke Yin.〕 The Duke of Lu met the Marquis of Qi at Fang. 〔Ninth year of Duke Yin.〕 The duke met the Marquis of Qi and the Earl of Zheng at Zhongqiu. The duke defeated the army of Song at Jian. 〔Both in the tenth year of Duke Yin.〕 The duke, together with the Marquis of Qi and the Earl of Zheng, entered Xu. 〔Eleventh year of Duke Yin.〕 In the first year, in spring, in the first month of the royal calendar, the duke acceded to the throne. The Earl of Zheng used a jade disc to obtain the use of the fields of Xu. 〔Both in the first year of Duke Huan.〕 The Marquis of Cai and the Earl of Zheng met at Deng. 〔Second year of Duke Huan.〕 Men of Chu attacked Zheng. 〔First year of Duke Xi.〕 Men of Chu invaded Zheng. 〔Second year of Duke Xi.〕 Men of Chu attacked Zheng. 〔Third year of Duke Xi.〕 The duke joined the Marquis of Qi, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Chen, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Zheng, the Baron of Xu, and the Earl of Cao in invading Cai. Cai collapsed, and they proceeded to attack Chu. 〔Fourth year of Duke Xi.〕 The feudal lords made a covenant at Kuiqiu. 〔Ninth year of Duke Xi.〕 Men of Chu destroyed Huang. 〔Twelfth year of Duke Xi.〕 Men of Chu defeated Xu at Loulin. 〔Fifteenth year of Duke Xi.〕 The Duke of Song, men of Cao, and men of Zhu made a covenant south of Cao. They met with men of Chen, Cai, Chu, and Zheng and made a covenant at Qi. 〔Both in the nineteenth year of Duke Xi.〕 Men of Song, Qi, and Chu made a covenant at Lushang. The Duke of Song, the Viscount of Chu, the Marquis of Chen, the Marquis of Cai, the Earl of Zheng, the Baron of Xu, and the Earl of Cao met at Yu. They seized the Duke of Song and used him to attack Song. 〔Both in the reign of Duke Xi …〕

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
〔二十一年〕
公會晋侯齊侯宋公蔡侯鄭伯衛子莒子
盟于踐土公朝于王所公會晋
侯齊侯宋公蔡侯鄭伯陳子莒子邾
子秦人于温天王狩于河陽公
朝于王所〔並僖公二十八年〕
公會齊侯于夾谷齊人來歸鄆讙龜陰
田〔並定公十年〕
禮記
===
有父之親有君之尊
故君子有禮則外諧而内無怨故物無不
懷仁鬼神饗德
天高地下萬物散殊而禮制行矣流而不
息合同而化而樂興焉春作夏長仁
也秋斂冬藏義也仁近於樂義近於
禮樂者敦和率神而從天禮者別宜
居鬼而從地
是故君子服其服則文以君子之容有其
punctuated:
〔二十一年〕
公會晋侯、齊侯、宋公、蔡侯、鄭伯、衛子、莒子，盟于踐土。公朝于王所。公會晋侯、齊侯、宋公、蔡侯、鄭伯、陳子、莒子、邾子、秦人于温。天王狩于河陽。公朝于王所。〔並僖公二十八年〕
公會齊侯于夾谷。齊人來歸鄆、讙、龜陰田。〔並定公十年〕
禮記
有父之親，有君之尊。
故君子有禮，則外諧而内無怨。故物無不懷仁，鬼神饗德。
天高地下，萬物散殊，而禮制行矣。流而不息，合同而化，而樂興焉。春作夏長，仁也；秋斂冬藏，義也。仁近於樂，義近於禮。樂者，敦和率神而從天；禮者，別宜居鬼而從地。
是故君子服其服，則文以君子之容；有其
translation_en:
…〔Twenty-first year of Duke Xi.〕
The duke met with the Marquis of Jin, the Marquis of Qi, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Cai, the Earl of Zheng, the Viscount of Wei, and the Viscount of Ju, and they made a covenant at Jiantu. The duke paid court at the king’s lodging. The duke met with the Marquis of Jin, the Marquis of Qi, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Cai, the Earl of Zheng, the Viscount of Chen, the Viscount of Ju, the Viscount of Zhu, and representatives of Qin at Wen. The Heavenly King hunted at Heyang. The duke paid court at the king’s lodging. 〔All in the twenty-eighth year of Duke Xi.〕
The duke met with the Marquis of Qi at Jiagu. Men of Qi came to return the lands of Yun, Huan, and Guiyin. 〔Both in the tenth year of Duke Ding.〕
Record of Rites (Liji)
He possesses the affection of a father and the dignity of a ruler.
Thus, when the gentleman observes ritual, there is harmony outwardly and no resentment within. Therefore, all beings cherish his benevolence, and ghosts and spirits accept the offerings made through his virtue.
Heaven is high and earth is low; the myriad things are dispersed and distinct, and the ordering of ritual operates among them. They flow without ceasing, unite and transform, and music arises among them. Spring’s burgeoning and summer’s growth are benevolence; autumn’s gathering and winter’s storing are righteousness. Benevolence is akin to music; righteousness is akin to ritual. Music deepens harmony, leads the spirits, and follows Heaven; ritual distinguishes what is fitting, gives the ghosts their dwelling places, and follows earth.
Therefore, when the gentleman wears the appropriate clothing, he embellishes it with a gentleman’s bearing; having his…

text:
容則文以君子之辭遂其辭則實以

第參場

translation_en:
…such a bearing, he adorns it with the words of a gentleman; carrying those words into effect, he gives them substance through the virtue of a gentleman.

Second Session
Discourse: The sages have rendered service to all under Heaven for ten thousand generations.
Imperial proclamations, appointment decrees, and memorials 〔one topic from among these [?]〕:
Compose an imperial proclamation in the manner of the Han dynasty ordering the commanderies and kingdoms to seek out overlooked worthy men. 〔The eleventh year of Emperor Gao.〕
Compose an appointment decree in the manner of the Tang dynasty appointing Li Jiang as Secretariat Drafter. 〔The fifth year of the Yuanhe reign of Emperor Xianzong.〕
Compose a memorial of thanks on behalf of a descendant of the Song Confucian scholar Yang Shi, upon an imperial decree enfeoffing Yang Shi as Earl of Jiangle and admitting him to associated worship in the Confucian temple.
Legal judgments 〔five cases〕:
Adding to or deleting from official documents.
Privately borrowing government carts or boats.
Demolishing a Pavilion for Publicizing Admonitions (shenming ting).
Convicts sentenced to penal servitude failing to perform their assigned labor.
Manufacturing or construction contrary to prescribed standards.

Third Session
Five policy questions.

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
問自古帝王之興必有文字之制故揚雄
曰聖人矢口而成言肆筆而成書以文
言之虞夏商周有明良之歌洛書之數
三風十愆之戒六爻上下之篇不可尚
已後世若大風猛士朱鴈白麟歌聲壯
麗宫體帝範孝經三傑體制清新以至
華山日出之詩宫花臘雪之句一時傳
誦膾炙人口雖非聖人之文其間得失
亦可言其故歟以字言之五帝三王有
===
龍書穗書之發軔有龜書鍾鼎之發揮
有倒薤鳥書之發迹不可尚已後世有
一札以賜萬國者有飛白以賜群臣者
有灑翰金鑾無愧淮南之書者有寄懷
翰墨滌煩盈尺之字者有澄神靜慮而
得之者有清心寡慾而得之者一時觀
覽照耀人目雖非聖人之書其間優劣
亦可論其實歟迨及我
朝
punctuated: 問：自古帝王之興，必有文字之制。故揚雄曰：「聖人矢口而成言，肆筆而成書。」以文言之，虞夏商周有明良之歌、洛書之數、三風十愆之戒、六爻上下之篇，不可尚已。後世若大風猛士、朱鴈白麟，歌聲壯麗；宫體帝範、孝經三傑，體制清新；以至華山日出之詩、宫花臘雪之句，一時傳誦，膾炙人口。雖非聖人之文，其間得失，亦可言其故歟？以字言之，五帝三王有龍書穗書之發軔，有龜書鍾鼎之發揮，有倒薤鳥書之發迹，不可尚已。後世有一札以賜萬國者，有飛白以賜群臣者，有灑翰金鑾、無愧淮南之書者，有寄懷翰墨、滌煩盈尺之字者，有澄神靜慮而得之者，有清心寡慾而得之者，一時觀覽，照耀人目。雖非聖人之書，其間優劣，亦可論其實歟？迨及我朝
translation_en:
Question: From antiquity, whenever emperors and kings arose, they invariably produced works of literature and writing. Thus Yang Xiong said: “When the sage opens his mouth, his words form a composition; when he freely applies his brush, his writing forms a text.” Speaking of literary composition, the ages of Yu, Xia, Shang, and Zhou possessed the song of the enlightened ruler and worthy ministers, the numbers of the Luo Writing, the admonition against the three pernicious customs and ten faults, and the writings on the six lines, upper and lower, of the hexagrams. These could not be surpassed. In later ages, such songs as those of the great wind and mighty warriors, the vermilion wild goose and white unicorn, were magnificent in sound; palace-style compositions, the Model for Emperors, the Classic of Filial Piety, and the Three Heroes [?] were fresh in form. There were also poems on Mount Hua and the rising sun, and lines on palace flowers and snow in the twelfth month. These were recited and transmitted in their day, winning universal acclaim. Although they were not compositions by sages, can you explain the reasons for their successes and shortcomings?

Speaking of written characters, under the Five Emperors and Three Kings there were the beginnings of dragon script and grain-ear script, the elaboration of tortoise script and writing on bells and tripods, and the emergence of inverted-leek-leaf script and bird script. These could not be surpassed. In later ages, some rulers bestowed a single sheet of writing upon the myriad states; some bestowed flying-white calligraphy upon their assembled ministers. Some wielded the brush in the Golden Phoenix Hall, producing calligraphy that need not feel ashamed beside that of Huainan [?]; some entrusted their feelings to brush and ink, dispelling vexation with writing that filled a foot of paper [?]. Some attained their skill by clarifying the spirit and quieting their thoughts; others by purifying the mind and reducing their desires. When viewed in their day, these works dazzled the eye. Although they were not the calligraphy of sages, can you discuss the actual grounds of their relative merits? Coming down to our dynasty…

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
聖祖
神孫相繼統治
皇文渙發涵蓄乎綱常禮義之端
宸翰鼎頒醞藉乎點畫形象之妙炳如河漢昭
若日星道在臣民功在天下蓋與五帝
三王之制同條共貫誠非漢唐宋所可
及者諸士子服習有年幸鋪張之以彰
昭代制作之盛
問虞廷有總章之訪洪範及卿士之謀集
===
議之制其來尚矣惟人主懷勝心則朝
廷無真議論士夫乏特操則天下無公
是非議之者合時措之宜決之者得至
當之理其為利也孰加哉試舉一二與
諸士子論之議擊匈奴古有之矣孰者
為是議行屯田亦有之矣孰者為優封
建之議魏徵胡為而辯蕭瑀復仇之議
子厚胡為而駁子昻議靈州之棄舍者
孰得其當議綏州之城否者孰得其宜
punctuated:
聖祖神孫相繼統治，皇文渙發，涵蓄乎綱常禮義之端；宸翰鼎頒，醞藉乎點畫形象之妙。炳如河漢，昭若日星，道在臣民，功在天下，蓋與五帝三王之制同條共貫，誠非漢唐宋所可及者。諸士子服習有年，幸鋪張之，以彰昭代制作之盛。
問：虞廷有總章之訪，《洪範》及卿士之謀，集議之制，其來尚矣。惟人主懷勝心，則朝廷無真議論；士夫乏特操，則天下無公是非。議之者合時措之宜，決之者得至當之理，其為利也孰加哉？試舉一二，與諸士子論之。議擊匈奴，古有之矣，孰者為是？議行屯田，亦有之矣，孰者為優？封建之議，魏徵胡為而辯蕭瑀？復仇之議，子厚胡為而駁子昻？議靈州之棄舍者，孰得其當？議綏州之城否者，孰得其宜？
translation_en:
…the sagely progenitor and his divine descendants have ruled in succession. Their imperial writings have issued forth in abundance, embodying the fundamental principles of the cardinal relationships, constant virtues, ritual propriety, and righteousness. Their imperial calligraphy has been munificently distributed, enfolding the subtleties of dots and strokes, forms and images. Brilliant as the Milky Way and luminous as the sun and stars, their Way resides among officials and people, and their achievements extend throughout the realm. Their works share the same principles and underlying coherence as the institutions of the Five Emperors and Three Kings; truly, they surpass anything attained under the Han, Tang, or Song. You candidates have studied and familiarized yourselves with them for years. Please expound upon them fully, to display the splendor of the cultural achievements and institutions of this illustrious age.
Question: At the court of Shun there was consultation in the Zongzhang [?]; the Great Plan also speaks of consulting high ministers and officers. The institution of collective deliberation has a long history indeed. Yet if the ruler harbors a desire to prevail over others, there will be no genuine deliberation at court; if scholar-officials lack independent integrity, there will be no impartial judgments of right and wrong in the realm. When those who deliberate propose measures appropriate to the circumstances, and those who decide arrive at the most fitting principles, what could yield greater benefit? Let us raise one or two examples for discussion with you candidates. There were debates in antiquity over attacking the Xiongnu: which arguments were right? There were also debates over establishing agricultural colonies: which proposals were superior? In the debate over enfeoffment, why did Wei Zheng dispute Xiao Yu’s position? In the debate over revenge, why did Zihou refute Zi’ang? Among those who debated abandoning Lingzhou, whose position was sound? Among those who debated whether to fortify Suizhou, whose position was appropriate? …

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
拒操之謀定於吳王之斫案平吳之策
決於晉主之推枰議出於下而斷決於
上所以照其是非者抑又何道歟願爲
我言之以備
廟堂之議
問周子博學力行早於聞道嘗作太極圖
通書易通數十篇然妙之所在莫過於
圖通書易通亦不越此圖之蘊耳是圖
者先生崛起千載得古聖微指於殘編
===
斷簡之中推本太極以及乎陰陽五行
之源布人物之化生人之爲至靈性之
爲至善萬物有宗萬事循則足以見先
王之治明孔孟之意可謂至矣盡矣朱
子謂先生之精因圖以示先生之蘊因
圖以發豈不信其然哉然而難者乃謂
其不當以繼善成性分陰陽不當以太
極陰陽分道器不當以仁義中正分體
用不當言體立而後用行不當偏指仁
punctuated:
拒操之謀，定於吳王之斫案；平吳之策，決於晉主之推枰。議出於下，而斷決於上，所以照其是非者，抑又何道歟？願爲我言之，以備廟堂之議。

問：周子博學力行，早於聞道，嘗作《太極圖》《通書》《易通》數十篇。然妙之所在，莫過於圖，《通書》《易通》亦不越此圖之蘊耳。是圖者，先生崛起千載，得古聖微指於殘編斷簡之中，推本太極，以及乎陰陽五行之源，布人物之化生、人之爲至靈、性之爲至善。萬物有宗，萬事循則，足以見先王之治，明孔孟之意，可謂至矣，盡矣。朱子謂先生之精因圖以示，先生之蘊因圖以發，豈不信其然哉？然而難者乃謂其不當以繼善成性分陰陽，不當以太極陰陽分道器，不當以仁義中正分體用，不當言體立而後用行，不當偏指仁
translation_en:
…The plan to resist Cao Cao was settled when the king of Wu chopped the table; the strategy to pacify Wu was decided when the ruler of Jin pushed aside the game board. Proposals arise below, while decisions are made above: by what means, then, is their rightness or wrongness discerned? Please explain this to me, to furnish material for deliberations at court.

Question: Master Zhou studied broadly and practiced diligently, coming early to an understanding of the Way. He composed the Diagram of the Supreme Ultimate (Taiji tu), the Penetrating Writing (Tongshu), and the Penetration of the Changes (Yitong), comprising several dozen chapters. Yet nowhere is his subtle understanding better expressed than in the Diagram; the Tongshu and Yitong likewise do not go beyond what this Diagram contains. In producing this Diagram, the Master emerged after a thousand years and grasped the subtle purport of the ancient sages amid fragmentary books and broken bamboo slips. He traced things back to the Supreme Ultimate, reaching the source of yin and yang and the Five Phases, and set forth the transformation and generation of human beings and other things, humanity’s supreme spiritual intelligence, and the supreme goodness of human nature. The myriad things have a common source, and all affairs follow their rules. This suffices to reveal the government of the former kings and clarify the intentions of Kongzi and Mengzi: it may be called the utmost and the fullest exposition. Master Zhu said that the Master’s essential understanding was shown through the Diagram, and his profound insights unfolded through it. Is this not indeed true?

Yet critics say that he ought not to distinguish yin and yang by ‘continuing goodness’ and ‘completing the nature’; that he ought not to distinguish the Way and concrete things by the Supreme Ultimate and yin and yang; that he ought not to distinguish substance and function by benevolence, righteousness, centrality, and correctness; that he ought not to say that substance is established and only afterward function operates; and that he ought not exclusively to identify benevolence…

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
爲陽動不當有仁義中正之分反其類
是數者之說然耶否耶間有不信同疑
異喜合惡離者又謂其傳自种穆之學
然則謂先生崛起得不傳之秘者非耶
又謂是圖非先生之至然則謂先生精
蘊因圖示發者非耶又謂先生太極一
圖終在伏羲先天範圍之內張子論氣
二章出入太極動靜陰陽之說果以其
規模之大小詳略言耶抑別有說耶諸
===
士子積學待問其於太極圖諸說諸書
之得失異同必講之熟矣願相與言之
以觀性理之學
問宋之言道學者莫不曰濂洛關閩則周
程張朱四夫子實爲宋倡道之首其他
姑未暇論而閩中之學則有親受之程
子而道遂南其授受之次至朱子而集
大成方其講道於閩也學者雲集而閩
士爲多竊嘗考之朱子有妻以女而註
punctuated:
爲陽動，不當有仁義中正之分反其類。是數者之說，然耶？否耶？間有不信同、疑異、喜合、惡離者，又謂其傳自种穆之學，然則謂先生崛起得不傳之秘者，非耶？又謂是圖非先生之至，然則謂先生精蘊因圖示發者，非耶？又謂先生太極一圖，終在伏羲先天範圍之內；張子論氣二章，出入太極動靜陰陽之說。果以其規模之大小詳略言耶？抑別有說耶？諸士子積學待問，其於太極圖諸說諸書之得失異同，必講之熟矣。願相與言之，以觀性理之學。

問：宋之言道學者，莫不曰濂洛關閩，則周程張朱四夫子，實爲宋倡道之首。其他姑未暇論，而閩中之學，則有親受之程子而道遂南。其授受之次，至朱子而集大成。方其講道於閩也，學者雲集，而閩士爲多。竊嘗考之，朱子有妻以女而註
translation_en:
…as yang in motion, and that there should not be a division into benevolence, righteousness, centrality, and correctness that reverses their categories [?]. Are these several assertions correct or not? Among them are those who distrust agreement, suspect differences, delight in concord, and dislike divergence; they further claim that his teaching was transmitted from the learning of Zhong and Mu. If so, is it wrong to say that the Master arose independently and grasped secrets whose transmission had been lost? They also say that this diagram does not represent the Master's highest attainment [?]. If so, is it wrong to say that his essential insights and profound understanding were displayed and revealed through the diagram? They further say that the Master's Diagram of the Supreme Ultimate ultimately remains within the scope of Fuxi's Prior Heaven scheme, and that Master Zhang's two chapters discussing qi move within and beyond the account of the Supreme Ultimate, movement and stillness, and yin and yang. Do these statements indeed concern the relative breadth of their scope and fullness of their treatment, or is there some other explanation? You examination candidates have accumulated learning in readiness for questioning. You must surely have thoroughly studied the merits and shortcomings, similarities and differences, of the various explanations and writings concerning the Diagram of the Supreme Ultimate. I invite you to discuss these matters, so that we may assess your learning concerning human nature and principle.

Question: Those who speak of the Learning of the Way in the Song invariably name Lian, Luo, Guan, and Min. Thus the four masters Zhou, Cheng, Zhang, and Zhu were truly the foremost advocates of the Way in the Song. For the moment, there is no time to discuss the others. As for learning in Min, there was one who received instruction personally from Master Cheng, and thus the Way came south. Through successive transmissions from teacher to disciple, it reached its comprehensive culmination in Master Zhu. When he was expounding the Way in Min, students gathered like clouds, and men of Min formed the majority. I have examined this matter: among Master Zhu's students was one to whom he married his daughter and who annotated…

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
經解者有呼為老友而註律呂新書者
有義理貫通洞見條緒者有端謹醇厚
天質近道者有潜心反覆而著書傳者
有留朱子之家而編中庸或問輯略者
又有附註家禮及祭禮者解易及尚書
者而其人皆不可以不知也夫道學一
脉之傳其盛如此不知當時閩士同聞
道伊洛與傳道南之學者此外復有其
人乎抑別有所論著否乎是又不可以
===
不知也諸生生長於閩沐群賢之遺化
非一日矣請詳舉其人以對毋徒諉曰
吾斯之未能信
問蒙以養正聖功也使養或弗端長益浮
靡欲其卒底於成也難矣故凡父兄之
於子弟必擇師立塾而施教則有所當
先者焉何謂四聲而調宜其先何謂六
體而明居其次若聲若體抑亦肇自何
人歟五聲所屬其音有在四聲旨義其
punctuated:
經解者，有呼為老友而註《律呂新書》者，有義理貫通、洞見條緒者，有端謹醇厚、天質近道者，有潜心反覆而著《書傳》者，有留朱子之家而編《中庸或問輯略》者，又有附註《家禮》及《祭禮》者、解《易》及《尚書》者，而其人皆不可以不知也。夫道學一脉之傳，其盛如此，不知當時閩士同聞道伊洛與傳道南之學者，此外復有其人乎？抑別有所論著否乎？是又不可以不知也。諸生生長於閩，沐群賢之遺化非一日矣，請詳舉其人以對，毋徒諉曰：「吾斯之未能信。」

問：蒙以養正，聖功也。使養或弗端，長益浮靡，欲其卒底於成也難矣。故凡父兄之於子弟，必擇師立塾而施教，則有所當先者焉。何謂四聲，而調宜其先？何謂六體，而明居其次？若聲若體，抑亦肇自何人歟？五聲所屬，其音有在；四聲旨義，其
translation_en:
…who annotated explanations of the classics; one whom he called an old friend and who annotated the New Book on Pitch Pipes; one who thoroughly grasped moral principles and clearly discerned their ramifications; one who was upright, circumspect, sincere, and generous, his natural disposition close to the Way; one who devoted himself to repeated reflection and wrote the Commentary on the Book of Documents; and one who stayed in Master Zhu’s household and compiled the Collected Essentials of Questions and Answers on the Doctrine of the Mean. There were also those who supplied supplementary annotations to the Family Rituals and the Sacrificial Rites, and those who explained the Book of Changes and the Book of Documents. These are all men whom one must know.

The transmission of this single lineage of Learning of the Way flourished to such a degree. Besides these men, were there other scholars from Fujian at that time who likewise learned the Way in the Yi and Luo region, or transmitted the learning through which the Way came south? Did they produce any other writings? These, too, are matters one must know. You students were born and raised in Fujian and have long benefited from the transforming legacy of these worthies. Please identify these men in detail in your answers; do not merely evade the question by saying, “In this I am not yet confident.”

Question: To nurture rectitude in the unformed is the work of a sage. If that nurturing is in any way improper, and those being raised become increasingly frivolous and extravagant as they grow, it will be difficult to bring them to eventual accomplishment. Thus, when fathers and elder brothers educate their sons and younger brothers, they must select teachers and establish schools; and in that instruction there are things that must come first. What are the four tones, and why should learning to modulate them come first? What are the six forms of writing, and why should understanding them come next? With whom did these tones and forms originate? Each of the five sounds has its corresponding phonetic category; as for the meaning and significance of the four tones, their …

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
實有拘若音若旨抑亦起自何代歟五
方之言清濁雜出音各殊配調聲之法
中指不與取象有歸然欲辨別其聲音
邪正之疑似必求夫要訣若撮唇齊齒
引喉平牙合口之類若捲舌唇上正齒
縱唇口開上鄂之屬固其訣也可得而
悉數其義歟殆如送氣隨鼻雙聲疊韻
莫不各有字類以紐其音此皆蒙之所
當學者之學也義理不玄遠而成用於
===
他日小可以該乎大近可以該乎遠者
未必不本於此庸可不以正而養之於
其始哉諸士子幼學於塾其得父兄師
友之薰陶者多矣願言之以為蒙鑑
punctuated: 實有拘。若音若旨，抑亦起自何代歟？五方之言，清濁雜出，音各殊配。調聲之法，中指不與，取象有歸。然欲辨別其聲音邪正之疑似，必求夫要訣。若撮唇、齊齒、引喉、平牙、合口之類，若捲舌、唇上、正齒、縱唇、口開、上鄂之屬，固其訣也，可得而悉數其義歟？殆如送氣、隨鼻、雙聲、疊韻，莫不各有字類以紐其音。此皆蒙之所當學者之學也。義理不玄遠，而成用於他日。小可以該乎大，近可以該乎遠者，未必不本於此。庸可不以正而養之於其始哉？諸士子幼學於塾，其得父兄師友之薰陶者多矣。願言之，以為蒙鑑。
translation_en: …are in fact subject to constraints. As for these sounds and their meanings, in what age did they originate? In the speech of the five regions, clear and voiced sounds occur in varied combinations, and the sounds have different correspondences. In the method of regulating sounds, the middle finger takes no part, and the symbolic correspondences have their assigned places [?]. Yet to distinguish doubtful cases of correct and incorrect pronunciation, one must seek the essential rules. Such techniques as pursing the lips, aligning the teeth, drawing from the throat, leveling the molars, and closing the mouth, and such others as curling the tongue, placing it above the lip [?], setting the teeth straight, relaxing the lips, opening the mouth, and raising it to the upper palate [?], are indeed such rules. Can you enumerate and explain all their meanings? As for aspiration, nasalization, shared initial sounds, and shared rhymes, each has classes of characters through which its sounds are linked. These are all matters that beginners ought to study. Their principles are neither abstruse nor remote, yet they become useful in later life. The ability to comprehend the great through the small and the distant through the near may well have its foundation here. How, then, could one fail to nurture beginners in what is correct from the outset? You candidates studied in village schools when young and have benefited greatly from the formative influence of fathers and elder brothers, teachers and friends. Please explain these matters, to provide a guide for beginners.
