章之句黼黻皇猷之文特其支流而已耳
噫蒙學雖小所關甚大其弟子於童稚之
===
年為父兄師友者當何如哉亦曰養之以
正而已謹對
punctuated: 與。殊不知，聲律既正，則放心可收。由此，言可以通乎道，聲可以宣乎言，小可以造乎大，近可以及乎遠。洒掃應對之節，修齊治平之理，皆可因言而得之矣。聖賢之閫雖難入也，可由此而入；君子之奥雖難造也，可由此而造。行由是順，志由是應，剛由是中，果何者而不造端於此哉？若夫詩賦詞章之句，黼黻皇猷之文，特其支流而已耳。噫！蒙學雖小，所關甚大。其弟子於童稚之年，為父兄師友者當何如哉？亦曰養之以正而已。謹對。
translation_en:
…has any part in it [?]. They fail to understand that, once sounds and their patterns are properly regulated, the wayward mind can be brought back. Through this, words can convey the Way, and sounds can give expression to words; the small can lead to the great, and the near can reach the distant. The rules of sprinkling and sweeping, responding and conversing, and the principles of cultivating oneself, ordering the family, governing the state, and bringing peace to the realm can all be apprehended through words. Though the inner precincts of the sages and worthies are difficult to enter, one can enter through this; though the profound understanding of the gentleman is difficult to attain, one can attain it through this. Conduct thereby becomes harmonious, intention responsive, and firmness balanced. What, indeed, does not have its beginning here? As for the lines of poems, rhapsodies, and literary compositions, and writings that embellish imperial plans, these are merely its offshoots.

Ah! Elementary learning may seem a small matter, but its implications are very great. While their children and pupils are still young, how should fathers, elder brothers, teachers, and friends act? The answer is simply to nurture them in what is right. Respectfully submitted in reply.

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
福建鄉試錄後序
弘治戊午秋士當大比先是
閩省藩臬重臣以事謀于巡
按監察御史張璥走聘淵等
以司文柄及期合八郡之士
而三試之遵
定制取九十名刻文之雋者為
===
錄以
獻淵宜序諸末竊惟三代無文
人六經無文法非無文人也
不以文論人非無文法也不
以文為法文以載道道得於
心而形於言言之成章則曰
文耳古謂仁義之人其言藹
punctuated:
福建鄉試錄後序

弘治戊午秋，士當大比。先是，閩省藩臬重臣以事謀于巡按監察御史張璥，走聘淵等以司文柄。及期，合八郡之士而三試之，遵定制取九十名，刻文之雋者為錄以獻。淵宜序諸末。

竊惟三代無文人，六經無文法。非無文人也，不以文論人；非無文法也，不以文為法。文以載道，道得於心而形於言，言之成章則曰文耳。古謂仁義之人，「其言藹
translation_en:
Postface to the Record of the Fujian Provincial Examination

In the autumn of the wuwu year of Hongzhi [1498], scholars were due to undergo the triennial examination. Before this, the senior officials of Fujian’s Provincial Administration Commission and Provincial Surveillance Commission consulted with the Regional Inspector, Investigating Censor Zhang Jing, about the matter. They dispatched invitations to me, Yuan, and others to take charge of assessing the compositions. When the appointed time came, the scholars of the eight prefectures were assembled and examined in three sessions. In accordance with the established regulations, ninety were selected. The finest compositions were printed as a record for presentation to the throne. It falls to me, Yuan, to write a postface at its close.

I humbly reflect that the Three Dynasties had no men of letters, and the Six Classics had no rules of composition. It was not that there were no men of letters: people were not judged by their writing. It was not that there were no rules of composition: literary form was not taken as the standard. Writing serves to convey the Way. The Way is apprehended in the heart and takes shape in words; when words acquire patterned form, this is simply called writing. As was said in antiquity of people endowed with benevolence and righteousness, “Their words are gracious…”

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
如也固有以哉昔歐陽子號
知道者猶曰文章足以潤身
政事足以及物殊不知文章
不達於政則晋唐諸子有華
無實耳政事不澤於文則東
漢三公有事無政耳噫文章
政事其可釐而二乎哉自鄉
===
舉里選之法肇於周孝弟力
田之法行於漢當時人皆知
道文亦近古裔是而後取士
制異或以策試或以詩試或
以詞賦試文之純駁而道之
得失以之雖未近古然掄材
育秀亦成一代家法迨我
punctuated: 如也，固有以哉！昔歐陽子號知道者，猶曰：「文章足以潤身，政事足以及物。」殊不知文章不達於政，則晋唐諸子有華無實耳；政事不澤於文，則東漢三公有事無政耳。噫！文章政事，其可釐而二乎哉？自鄉舉里選之法肇於周，孝弟力田之法行於漢，當時人皆知道，文亦近古。裔是而後，取士制異，或以策試，或以詩試，或以詞賦試。文之純駁，而道之得失以之。雖未近古，然掄材育秀，亦成一代家法。迨我
translation_en:
…so richly expressed—surely there is a reason for this! In former times, Master Ouyang, reputed to understand the Way, nevertheless said: “Literary composition suffices to adorn oneself; government affairs suffice to benefit others.” He failed to recognize that if literary composition does not extend to governance, then the various masters of the Jin and Tang possess ornament without substance; if government affairs are not enriched by literary cultivation, then the Three Dukes of the Eastern Han conduct business without achieving good government. Alas! Can literary composition and government affairs be separated into two distinct things?

The system of recommending men from townships and selecting them from villages originated under the Zhou, and the system of promoting the filial, the fraternal, and those diligent in farming was practiced under the Han. People at that time all understood the Way, and their writing, too, approached that of antiquity. Thereafter [?], systems for selecting officials differed: some tested candidates through policy essays, some through poetry, and some through lyric compositions and rhapsodies. The purity or mixed character of their writing, and their success or failure in attaining the Way, depended on these methods. Although they did not approach antiquity, their selection of talent and cultivation of outstanding men nevertheless established distinctive practices for each dynasty. When our …

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
朝設科取士崇儒右文其程式
則詳酌古制其額例則度量
時宜其遴選則務協輿論取
士之法至是大備以是百餘
年來文化誕敷無遠弗屆况
福建爲東南大藩古爲閩越
地隋唐以前文物固尠自常
===
袞入閩而文風始變自歐陽
詹來泉山而文運始開自蕭
國梁鄭僑黃定百里三狀元
而文物始昌至我朱子講道
延平光啓正學而文教爲之
大振迨今
之盛作養日深彬彬乎冠蓋
punctuated: 朝設科取士，崇儒右文。其程式則詳酌古制，其額例則度量時宜，其遴選則務協輿論。取士之法，至是大備。以是百餘年來，文化誕敷，無遠弗屆。况福建爲東南大藩，古爲閩越地，隋唐以前，文物固尠。自常袞入閩，而文風始變；自歐陽詹來泉山，而文運始開；自蕭國梁、鄭僑、黃定，百里三狀元，而文物始昌。至我朱子講道延平，光啓正學，而文教爲之大振。迨今之盛，作養日深，彬彬乎冠蓋
translation_en: …our dynasty established examinations to recruit men for office, honoring Confucian learning and esteeming literary accomplishment. Their procedures were formulated through careful consideration of ancient institutions; their quotas were determined with regard to the needs of the times; and their selection of candidates sought to accord with public judgment. The methods of recruiting officials thus became fully developed. Consequently, for more than a hundred years, civilizing influences have spread widely, reaching even the most distant places. Moreover, Fujian is a great province of the southeast, anciently the territory of Minyue. Before the Sui and Tang dynasties, its cultural attainments were indeed few. When Chang Gun entered Fujian, its literary ethos began to change; when Ouyang Zhan came to Quanshan, its literary fortunes began to unfold; and with Xiao Guoliang, Zheng Qiao, and Huang Ding—three top-ranking Palace Examination graduates within a hundred li—its cultural accomplishments began to flourish. Then our Master Zhu expounded the Way at Yanping, illuminating and opening the path to orthodox learning, thereby giving a powerful impetus to literary and moral education. Now, in this flourishing age, the cultivation and nurturing of talent deepen daily. How refined are the capped officials and their canopied carriages…

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
之相望也渢渢乎絃誦之相
聞也比比乎科第之相輝也
較昔蓋倍蓰矣雖然始善須
慮其終文盛當防其敝諸士
子生斯世也際斯運也領斯
薦也亦云盛矣盍思所以慎
之其必砥名礪節無忘常袞
===
之所教者崇德尚義無愧歐
陽詹之所造者含英咀華無
劣鄭僑輩之所獻者而又究
極精微之蘊酌以義理之中
無失朱子之所傳者慎而又
慎俾後世不徒以文人文法
稱庶無負我
punctuated: 之相望也，渢渢乎絃誦之相聞也，比比乎科第之相輝也，較昔蓋倍蓰矣。雖然，始善須慮其終，文盛當防其敝。諸士子生斯世也，際斯運也，領斯薦也，亦云盛矣，盍思所以慎之？其必砥名礪節，無忘常袞之所教者；崇德尚義，無愧歐陽詹之所造者；含英咀華，無劣鄭僑輩之所獻者；而又究極精微之蘊，酌以義理之中，無失朱子之所傳者。慎而又慎，俾後世不徒以文人文法稱，庶無負我
translation_en: …appear one after another; the ample sounds of strings and recitation are heard on every side; and examination successes repeatedly lend one another lustre. Compared with former times, these have increased severalfold. Nevertheless, when the beginning is good, one must consider the end; when literary culture flourishes, one must guard against its deterioration. You scholars were born into this age, have encountered this favourable moment, and have received this recommendation through the Provincial Examination: this may indeed be called a flourishing state of affairs. Why not consider how to proceed with due care? You must burnish your reputations and temper your integrity, never forgetting what Chang Gun taught; exalt virtue and esteem righteousness, proving worthy of what Ouyang Zhan achieved; savour the finest literary essence, offering nothing inferior to the contributions of Zheng Qiao and his peers. Beyond this, you must thoroughly explore the deepest subtleties and weigh them against the proper mean of moral principle, losing nothing of what Master Zhu transmitted. Be cautious, and cautious yet again, so that later generations will praise you for more than literary accomplishment and mastery of composition. Thus, it is hoped, you will not fail our …

title: 弘治十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
□作育之
脫或孜孜汲汲藉文以媒利
禄是豈徒科目之羞抑亦爲
斯文之羞也可不勗哉
山東濟南府濱州儒學學正
周淵謹序
punctuated:
□作育之。脫或孜孜汲汲，藉文以媒利禄，是豈徒科目之羞，抑亦爲斯文之羞也。可不勗哉！

山東濟南府濱州儒學學正周淵謹序。
translation_en:
…the nurturing and education bestowed by [illegible] [?]. If, however, they strive incessantly and anxiously, using literary accomplishment to secure profit and official emoluments, would this merely disgrace the examination system? It would also disgrace this cultural tradition. Can they fail to exert themselves!

Zhou Yuan, Instructor of the Confucian School of Binzhou, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong, respectfully composed this preface.
